items.prompt: Before rotate(grid), saved_row=grid[0]. The shown function only reads grid cells and builds joined strings. What must hold afterward?

options.text: saved_row becomes the new first output row.
options.why: No assignment targets an input row; returning output strings does not overwrite the saved list.

options.text: grid loses its first row when it is consumed.
options.why: Index reads do not remove rows or cells. There is no pop or deletion.

options.text: saved_row is the same unchanged input list.
options.why: The shown construction creates new output strings and never writes through the caller row alias.

options.text: grid is sorted by the joined output text.
options.why: No sort is present, and coordinate traversal does not mutate caller order.

items.explanation: The shown construction creates new output strings and never writes through the caller row alias.
